Job Description: Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in
cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools,
outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. Our
focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the industrial,
construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement,
repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio includes
MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® - recognized worldwide for their deep
heritage and innovative product platforms of superior quality. The
company maintains a global manufacturing and product development
footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately US$15.2
billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring exceptional people
is a top focus at TTI. This drives a high-performance culture across
all levels of our organization and helps to achieve our vision of
being number one in the industries we serve. Our unique high-speed
decision-making process supports our acute focus on developing
superior products and meeting high customer expectations. We view our
winning culture as a competitive advantage that powers our growth. To
strengthen our team in Winnenden (Stuttgart area) as soon as possible,
we are looking for a Junior Project Leader (f-m-d) Engineering -
Milwaukee® Key Responsibilities: Lead and develop NPD projects in
EMEA in accordance with our development process on all technical
aspects for design and development Coordinate technical aspects in the
NPD Project for Professional Products EMEA or ROW driven Check
NPQ/PEAC/CTQs and coordinate results between Product Management,
Quality, Regulatory, Reliability and After Sales and prepare for EMEA
sign-off to provide a technical specification meeting to the customer
expectation Participate in the 2D/3D design reviews with Product
Management and Engineering Work closely with external partners and
vendors within the New Development Project Coordinate the Sample
Inspection Report with Product Management (EMEA), Engineering and
Quality teams (PRC) to support the pilot run approval and the
subsequent release for mass production Determine with team on
temporary deviation and releases Make technical file available for TTI
EMEA on product level and check integrity of the technical file Assess
and sign off temporary deviation for engineering if necessary, during
mass production Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
technical education, preferably in mechanical or engineering or a
related field Ideally experience in project management and product
development Good understanding of technical processes in engineering
like product development, technical documentation Ideally experienced
in Personal Protective Equipment or Power Tools business Excellent
command of German and English, both written and spoken, another
European language is of advantage Extensive experience with MS Office
application Knowledge in CAD system Willingness to travel according to
business need (20% approx.) Your perks: An interesting position with
an attractive company – recognized as a "top employer” by kununu
Company pension scheme Free parking spaces directly next to the office
and good public transport connections Fresh fruit, water and hot
beverages for free Company fitness via "EGYM Wellpass" EAP (mental
support for employees) Learning platforms such as "GoodHabitz" and

- A wide range of employee benefits/perks

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant / Manager - Risk Management (Liquidity and Market Price Risk) (f|m|x) (Leiter/in - Risikomanagement)
jobs.description:
As a Senior Consultant / Manager (f|m|x), you advise our clients in
the banking sector and financial services industry on complex topics
related to liquidity and market price risk. You analyze their current
situation, identify new requirements early on and, together with your
team, develop tailored solutions – from the initial idea all the way
to implementation. In this role, you effectively drive the continued
development of your clients’ liquidity risk management, enabling
well‑founded decision-making. You assume subject-matter
responsibility, manage collaboration within the project and shape the
content development of our consulting approaches. Your tasks: You
support and lead exciting (sub-)projects at banks and financial
services providers in their liquidity and market price risk
management, taking full responsibility – from gap analyses and the
design of client-specific solutions through to implementation. You
develop integrated management approaches for liquidity and market
price risk, bank-wide liquidity risk stress tests and quantitative
modeling frameworks, for example for risk measurement or interest
rate, margin and liquidity cash flow analyses. In addition, you design
methodological frameworks (for example in the ILAAP context) and
develop solutions to implement IRRBB and CSRBB requirements as well as
net interest income (NII) simulations. As part of your role, you also
ensure the effective integration of regulatory requirements, for
instance with respect to ICAAP and ILAAP as well as IRRBB and CSRBB.
You take responsibility for your own deliverables and those of your
team and proactively advance topics. With your strong team orientation
and professionalism, you foster trust-based collaboration – both
within the team and with our clients. You also mentor junior
colleagues, developing both their professional capabilities and
personal strengths, and thus contribute to the team’s growth. You
actively help shape the ongoing enhancement of our consulting
portfolio, identify relevant market potential at an early stage and
derive concrete ideas from it. With your expertise, you support the
development of new offerings and the acquisition of new client
mandates. Your skills: You hold a degree in mathematics, (business)
informatics, physics, statistics or economics, ideally supplemented by
certifications such as FRM or CFA. You have at least three years of
professional experience in consulting or the financial industry.
Proven involvement in leading bank-specific implementation projects in
liquidity and market price risk management is an advantage, and
initial exposure to specialist leadership (for example coordinating
team members) is also part of your profile. You have a solid
understanding of liquidity and market price risk management as well as
the ICAAP and ILAAP frameworks. You confidently apply your analytical
and quantitative skills in modeling and data analysis; programming
skills in Python or R are explicitly welcome. You are familiar with
relevant European and German regulatory requirements, including EBA
Guidelines on IRRBB and CSRBB, SREP requirements, ICAAP and ILAAP.
Initial experience in dealing professionally with external audits is a
plus. You work and think in a structured and solution-oriented manner
and communicate clearly. A client- and team-oriented way of working
comes naturally to you, especially when assuming responsibility within
a team and engaging effectively with different people and situations.
You have excellent command of the German language (at least C1 level,
business-fluent proficiency) and good English language skills (at
least B2 level, fluent), both written and spoken. #LI-LARA #LI-hybrid
Your benefits Insurances & Pension Schemes: Safely on the road with
zeb—in Germany, you are also privately insured via a group accident
insurance policy. For business trips abroad, there is an additional
travel health insurance and you can also take out a company pension
plan with zeb. Mobile Work: Thanks to our technical equipment, remote
work is possible from anywhere – regardless of whether you are on
the train, at home or in the office. zeb.life: Your life is
changing—and we would like to accompany you through the different
phases. zeb.life offers you support for example in childcare, life
situation management and eldercare or in finding concierge services.
Working Time Models: The principle of "trust-based hours” applies
for all our employees, enabling flexible schedules. For permanent
employees, part-time models are also possible: you can develop your
part-time model in consultation with your CDC (Career Development
Counselor) and in consideration of your project and adapt it as
required. Define your working time model according to your personal
needs and adapt your working hours to your current life situation. As
a contract model, Family & More offers a guarantee of travel-free
weekdays that are contractually fixed. Depending on the reduction of
travel activities, your salary will be adjusted for a fixed period of
time.

Job Description EuroChem is one of the leading manufacturers of
fertilizers, with a long-standing presence in Europe and many
countries overseas. With our broad product portfolio, we offer plant
nutrition solutions for every application, including field
fertilization, fertigation, and foliar fertilization. The Supply &
Operations Planning Manager is a central integrator between the
production site and the regional and local Sales organizations. As
part of the regional team in Mannheim, you take full responsibility
for demand planning, supply balancing, and commercial scenario
development for a defined product group and/or a specific production
site in Europe. We are looking for a committed and experienced: Supply
& Operations Planning Manager (m/w/d) Your Key Responsibilities in
detail: Lead S&OP Planning for a Defined Product Portfolio or
Production Site Own the end-to-end S&OP planning cycle for your
assigned products/sites, ensuring a robust, transparent and efficient
planning process while balancing the interdependencies of continuous
fertilizer production, customer service, production stability,
logistics constraints, working capital and financial performance
Integrate commercial priorities into the planning process by
evaluating business opportunities, optimizing contribution margins,
prioritizing markets and ensuring the optimal deployment of
constrained production capacities Facilitate commercial
decision-making in close collaboration with the Commercial Lead
(responsible for the production site or the European commercial
organization) Commercial & Operational Planning Validate demand
forecasts, evaluate commercial opportunities, identify supply gaps or
surpluses and align production capabilities with Sales Managers and
the Commercial Lead Allocation & prioritization: Define & adjust
product allocations and market priorities (planned product volume/
price-positions) in close collaboration with Sales and Supply Chain
Execution to establish delivery commitments and operational priorities
Support working capital optimization by incorporating Order-to-Cash
(OTC) cycle-time considerations into planning decisions using sales
input and historical performance data Inventory, Production & Shipment
Monitoring Tracking regional inventory targets to balance service
levels, production stability and capital efficiency Monitor the
Production–Shipment Plan (actual vs. planned performance), identify
deviations early and initiate necessary corrective actions, such as
accelerated delivery or reallocation of volumes Your Qualification:
Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial
Engineering or comparable field 2 to 5 years professional work
experience in Supply Chain Planning would be an advantage Strong
analytical and commercial thinking skills; ability to balance
trade-offs and drive decisions Structured, proactive and hands-on
approach in dynamic environments Very good communication and
stakeholder management skills High IT affinity; strong Excel skills;
experience with S&OP planning tools is a plus Fluent English (written
and spoken); additional languages are beneficial Enjoy working in a
collaborative, supportive team culture Kontakt Like to work
independently and on your own responsibility? Entrepreneurial thinking
and acting is a matter of course for you? Then we should get to know
each other! Please send your detailed CV in English to Human
Resources, attention Andreas Wagner Andreas.Wagner@eurochem.group

About the company My client is a leading high-tech startup
specializing in the research and development of products in the field
of artificial intelligence and autonomous systems . The goal is to
transform pioneering research results into marketable products and to
translate the latest insights of AI into practical applications . With
innovative solutions and technologies, they strive to ensure that
their customers can take a leading position in the constantly evolving
AI landscape. (Senior) AI Engineer - Kotlin, Java, TypeScript (m/w/d)
In permanent full-time employment Salary: 60.000 – 120.000 €
brutto / Jahr Location: Munich Ref. 31411 The Role You will work
directly with the CEO as a technical generalist , removing technical
blockers across the entire technology stack . You will develop
features, configure systems, build integrations, investigate technical
challenges, and create prototypes—exactly where the greatest impact
is currently needed. This is not a pure engineering role and not a
pure product role . It is operator work with technical substance : you
will read and write code, design architectures, work with
infrastructure, and reliably bring solutions into production. The
decisive factor is not processing tickets but sustainably resolving
technical blockers and quickly validating new ideas . You work
AI-natively : Claude Code, agentic workflows, and automation tools are
part of your daily toolkit. Your Responsibilities Identifying and
independently resolving technical blockers in customer projects,
product development, or infrastructure Implementing features in the
Kotlin backend or TypeScript frontend and targetedly expanding
existing systems Configuring customer-specific workflows,
integrations, and automations Implementing new concepts as prototypes:
AI agents , integrations, internal tools, or dashboards Reviewing pull
requests with a view to system boundaries, architecture, and component
transitions Investigating production issues together with the
engineering team and taking responsibility for their resolution until
completion Consistently utilizing AI tools: Claude Code, agent chains,
MCP servers , and customized automations are part of your standard
toolkit What the role is NOT Not a traditional software developer
position with responsibility for a single codebase – you work where
technical solutions create the greatest value Not a pure product
management role – you technically implement solutions yourself
instead of exclusively documenting requirements Not a data science or
ML research position – the focus is on transforming AI technologies
into marketable products Not a remote-only position – collaborating
within the Munich team is an important part of the role Not a role for
people who consider AI tools optional – modern AI development tools
are part of your daily way of working Your Profile Degree in computer
science, business informatics , or comparable practical experience
Confident handling of existing codebases in Kotlin, Java, TypeScript
,or Python – you can implement features independently and expand
existing systems AI-native way of working : You use Claude Code or
comparable tools daily , develop your own small tools, and know both
the strengths and limitations of AI assistants Systemic thinking : You
understand components, interfaces, error scenarios, and technical
trade-offs Enjoyment of ambiguous situations : Requirements evolve,
priorities change, and clarity arises through the work Personal
responsibility : You take ownership of a blocker and drive it to a
solution – even if you have to learn new things along the way

Tel. 0049 228 286 59 410 www.karesources.com

About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards a greener future,
the demand for raw materials—minerals and metals—is set to
increase immensely over the next three decades. Europe faces a
critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these essential
resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps in. EIT
RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. Tasks Information Management &
Architecture Design, implement, and continuously improve the
organization's information and document management architecture. Own
the Microsoft 365 and SharePoint information management environment.
Ensure integration with ERP, CRM, business applications, and the wider
IT landscape. Define information architecture, metadata, taxonomy,
access controls, and governance standards. Ensure scalable, secure,
and future-ready information management solutions. Document Management
& Governance Lead the development and operation of the Document
Management System (DMS). Establish governance for document
organization, metadata, permissions, lifecycle management, and
information classification. Define standards for document storage,
retrieval, version control, and collaboration. Ensure information
remains accessible, structured, and compliant throughout its
lifecycle. Compliance & Process Automation Translate legal,
regulatory, and business requirements into effective information
management solutions. Manage document retention, archiving, and
records management processes. Ensure compliant, audit-ready
information storage and governance. Design and optimize automated
workflows, approvals, electronic signatures, and lifecycle processes.
Drive continuous improvements in efficiency and user experience using
Microsoft 365 technologies. Digital Workplace & User Enablement Own
information management and digital workplace solutions within IT
Operations. Promote best practices for collaboration, document
management, and knowledge sharing. Evaluate and implement enhancements
that improve governance and usability. Deliver training, user
documentation, onboarding materials, and guidance for Microsoft 365,
SharePoint, DMS platforms, and emerging technologies such as Copilot.
Vendor Management & Security Manage implementation partners,
consultants, and external service providers. Ensure solution quality,
governance, security, and alignment with business objectives. Oversee
implementations, enhancements, and ongoing solution performance.
Ensure compliance with IT security standards, ISO 27001, and
information governance requirements. Collaborate with security, legal,
